# Collaborative Filtering

## Load Data

```{r, message= F}
library(recommenderlab)
movies = read.csv("../ml-32m/movies.csv")
ratings = read.csv("../ml-32m/ratings.csv")
links = read.csv("../ml-32m/links.csv")
tags = read.csv("../ml-32m/tags.csv")
```

## Code Sourced from IE 5533

```{r}
ratingsMatrix = as(ratings, "realRatingMatrix")

# Only consider users that have rated at least 100 movies
MovieLense100 <- ratingsMatrix[rowCounts(ratingsMatrix)>100,]

# Sample 1,000 random row indices from the matrix
n_samples = 1000
MovieLense100Sample <- MovieLense100[sample(1:nrow(MovieLense100), n_samples, replace = FALSE),]
```

```{r}
split <- sample(c("TRUE", "FALSE"),
                prob = c(0.8, 0.2),
                size = nrow(MovieLense100Sample),
                replace="TRUE")

train <- subset(MovieLense100Sample, split == "TRUE")
test  <- subset(MovieLense100Sample, split == "FALSE")

```

```{r}
# User-Based Collaborative Filtering
rec_system <- Recommender(data = train,
                          method = "UBCF")

# predict top-3 (n = 3) items for each user in test data
recommendations <- predict(rec_system,
                           newdata = test,
                           n = 3)

recommendations

# predict ratings for all unknown items in test set
rating_predictions <- predict(rec_system,
                              newdata = test,
                              type = "ratings")

# Evaluation via Cross Validation against Benchmarks

scheme <- evaluationScheme(MovieLense100Sample,
                           method = "cross-validation",
                           k = 50,
                           given = 15,
                           goodRating = 4)

scheme


algorithms <- list(`random items` = list(name = "RANDOM", param = NULL),
                   `popular items` = list(name = "POPULAR", param = NULL),
                   `user-based CF` = list(name = "UBCF", param = list(nn = 3)))


results <- evaluate(scheme,
                    algorithms,
                    type = "topNList",
                    n = c(1, 3, 5, 10, 20),
                    progress = FALSE)

plot(results, annotate = 2, legend = "topleft")
plot(results, "prec/rec", annotate=3, legend="topleft")

res <- evaluate(scheme,
                algorithms,
                type = "ratings",
                progress = FALSE)

plot(res, col = 1:length(algorithms))
```
